text: DSH 快捷模型选择器是一款适用于 Web 客户端的 DSH 插件，在输入框旁接管模型选择区域。它读取当前会话的模型目录，提供按模型名、服务商和模型 ID 搜索、最近使用与收藏置顶、服务商分组折叠，以及独立的推理强度选择。用户可用方向键、Enter 和快捷键完成切换；窄窗口会调整布局。适合模型较多、需要频繁切换的 DSH 用户。无需额外 API Key；偏好保存在浏览器本地。

DSH Quick Model Selector replaces the Web composer picker. Search by model, provider, or ID; pin favorites and recent picks; fold provider groups; set reasoning effort separately. Keyboard shortcuts speed switching. It adapts to narrow layouts and stores preferences locally.
想按模型名或服务商快速筛选 DSH 里的模型。
模型列表太长了，能不能把常用和刚用过的放到前面？
我想收藏几个常用模型，并在会话里快速切换。
让模型很多的服务商分组默认折叠，列表更好浏览。
能在选择模型的同时单独调整推理强度吗？
I want to search DSH models by provider or model name.
Can I pin favorite and recently used models for faster switching?
I need a compact model picker with a separate reasoning-effort control.
DSH 快捷模型选择器的功能「模型搜索」：打开模型面板后可输入关键词，按模型名、服务商名称或模型 ID 筛选；多个词须同时匹配，结果按相关度排序。
DSH 快捷模型选择器的功能「最近与收藏」：选中模型后记录到最近列表，星标可收藏；面板将最近使用和收藏置顶，偏好保存在浏览器 localStorage。
DSH 快捷模型选择器的功能「服务商分组」：模型按服务商分组，超过六个模型的组默认折叠，当前模型或含收藏的组保持展开；用户可手动切换并记住状态。
DSH 快捷模型选择器的功能「键盘切换」：在模型面板中用方向键移动、Enter 选择，也可用 Ctrl 或 Command 加数字快速选择可见项，Ctrl 或 Command 加 D 切换收藏。
DSH 快捷模型选择器的功能「推理强度」：当前模型提供推理选项时，可通过独立弹层选择强度；空间不足时入口移入模型菜单，选择后更新当前会话模型设置。

dsh-quick-model-selector README · DSH 快捷模型选择器：[English](README.en.md) · 中文 一只橘 oranji 的 DSH 插件。 **模型越来越多，切换不该越来越麻烦。** 接入了好几个 provider，模型列表越拉越长；明明只想换回刚才那个，却又得从头翻一遍。 快捷模型选择器让 DSH 里的模型更好找：刚用过的就在最上面，常用的收藏紧随其后，想找哪个就输入几个字。少翻列表，把注意力留给眼前的对话。

dsh-quick-model-selector README · 用起来有什么不同？：- **想找哪个，直接打字**：打开就能搜，输入模型名或 provider 名即可缩小范围，不必挨个展开分组。
- **常用的，不用反复找**：最近使用和收藏都置顶，刚用过的排在最前，换回上一个模型只需点一下。
- **模型再多，也有条理**：超过 6 个模型的 provider 默认收起，当前模型和收藏所在的组保持展开；你手动调整的折叠状态也会记住。
- **倍率不用藏在长名字里**：`x0.28` 这类倍率单独显示为彩色角标，扫一眼就能分辨。
- **换模型、调推理，各管各的**：推理强度有独立按钮，不必在模型列表里来回找；不支持时自动隐藏。
- **手不离键盘，也能切换**：方向键选、Enter 确认，`⌘1–⌘9` 快选、`⌘D` 收藏（也支持 Ctrl）。
- **窗口变窄，按钮也不乱跑**：窄框下模型按钮固定为 150px，长名称用省略号收尾，悬停查看全名；实际空间不足时进一步收窄，推理强度移入模型菜单，给麦克风和发送按钮留出位置。窗口放宽后恢复独立的强度按钮。

dsh-quick-model-selector README · 安装：**插件页（推荐）**：设置 → 插件 → 添加插件 → 「包名或地址」填

```
https://github.com/SnailMann/dsh-quick-model-selector
```

装完按提示重启一次 DSH Desktop。重启后在「已安装插件」里能看到 `dsh-quick-model-selector`，可随时开关或卸载。

**命令行**（等价，`web` 是 Desktop 用的 profile 名）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:SnailMann/dsh-quick-model-selector
```

`dist/` 已随仓库提交，安装不需要编译，也不会触发 pnpm 的构建脚本审批。

**从源码**（想改代码时）：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/SnailMann/dsh-quick-model-selector.git
cd dsh-quick-model-selector
dsh plugin --profile web add .
```

dsh-quick-model-selector README · 安装：改完 `src/` 要 `npm run build` 再重启 DSH。

已在 DSH Desktop 0.12.1 / Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 验证：插件列表可见可开关，启用装配 1 条插件行、停用 0 条。

dsh-quick-model-selector README · 使用：点输入框右下角的模型按钮，剩下的都在表里：

| 键 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 直接打字 | 过滤列表 |
| ↑ / ↓ | 移动高亮（焦点留在搜索框） |
| Enter | 选中当前高亮 |
| Esc | 先清空搜索词，再按一次关闭；在强度弹层里直接关闭 |
| Tab | 无搜索词时折叠 / 展开当前分组；连续按可恢复刚折叠的组（Shift+Tab 返回前一个控件） |
| ⌘1 – ⌘9（或 Ctrl+1–9） | 直选第 N 个可见项 |
| ⌘D（或 Ctrl+D） | 收藏 / 取消收藏当前高亮 |

鼠标同样可用：点行选中、点星标收藏、点分组头折叠。

偏好存在 `localStorage` 的 `dsh-quick-model-selector:prefs:v1`，全局共享、不区分会话；从旧包名 `dsh-model-palette` 升级时旧键会自动迁移，收藏与折叠状态不丢。

dsh-quick-model-selector README · 卸载：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-quick-model-selector
```

只移除自身登记，会话、模型配置和偏好都保留；重启后恢复官方模型选择器。

dsh-quick-model-selector README · 开发：改 `src/` 后 `npm run build` 再 `npm test`；`node scripts/preview.mjs <dir>` 可把真实组件渲染成静态页看排版。

浏览器交互测试使用本机 DSH profile 的 React 和 Playwright，覆盖键盘操作、320–800px 工具栏宽度、模型名省略、其他控件文字变化和弹层边界。通过 `NODE_PATH` 提供 Playwright 后运行 `npm test`；使用系统 Chrome 时加上 `QMS_BROWSER_CHANNEL=chrome`。缺少依赖时会明确跳过浏览器测试，不能替代真实 DSH 验证。静态预览不执行布局观察器，响应式行为以浏览器测试和真实宿主为准。

dsh-quick-model-selector README · DSH Quick Model Selector： A DSH plugin by 一只橘 oranji. English · [中文](README.md) Takes over the model seat at the bottom right of the DSH composer: instead of one long flat list of every provider, you get a search-first panel with favorites and recents pinned on top, collapsed provider groups, and reasoning effort as a separate second control. Built for setups with dozens or hundreds of models.

dsh-quick-model-selector README · Features：- **Search first** — the panel opens with the cursor in the search box. Matching covers model name, provider name and model id; space-separated terms are ANDed.
- **Recents, then favorites** — what you just used sits at the very top, favorites right below it.
- **Collapsible groups** — providers with more than six models start collapsed; the group holding the current model or a favorite stays open, and manual folding is remembered.
- **Multiplier badges** — an `x0.28` token in the model name becomes a row-end badge, colored ≤0.3 green, ≤0.8 amber, >0.8 red.
- **Separate reasoning effort** — its own button, popover and focus; hidden entirely when the current model has no reasoning support.
- **Keyboard** — `⌘1–⌘9` quick pick, `⌘D` favorite, `Tab` fold, arrows plus Enter.
- **Narrow rows stay orderly** — the model button has a fixed 150px width with an ellipsis and its full name on hover. It shrinks further when necessary to leave room for the microphone and send button; reasoning effort moves into the model menu and returns beside it when space permits.

dsh-quick-model-selector README · Install：**Plugin page (recommended)** — Settings → Plugins → Add plugin, and put this in "package name or address":

```
https://github.com/SnailMann/dsh-quick-model-selector
```

Then restart DSH Desktop once as prompted. The plugin appears as `dsh-quick-model-selector` under installed plugins and can be toggled or removed at any time.

**Command line** — same thing, where `web` is the profile DSH Desktop uses:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:SnailMann/dsh-quick-model-selector
```

dsh-quick-model-selector README · Install：`dist/` is committed, so installing needs no build step and triggers no pnpm build-script approval.

**From source** — when you want to change the code:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/SnailMann/dsh-quick-model-selector.git
cd dsh-quick-model-selector
dsh plugin --profile web add .
```

After editing `src/`, run `npm run build` and restart DSH.
dsh-quick-model-selector README · Install：Verified on DSH Desktop 0.12.1 / Harness 0.2.1-rc.2: visible and toggleable in the plugin list, one composed plugin row when enabled and none when disabled.
dsh-quick-model-selector README · Usage：Click the model button at the bottom right of the composer; the rest is in this table:

dsh-quick-model-selector README · Usage：| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Typing | Filters the list |
| ↑ / ↓ | Move the highlight (focus stays in the search box) |
| Enter | Select the highlighted row |
| Esc | Clears the search term first, closes on the second press; closes directly inside the effort popover |
| Tab | With no search query, fold / unfold the current group; press again to restore it (Shift+Tab moves to the previous control) |
| ⌘1 – ⌘9 (or Ctrl+1–9) | Pick the Nth visible row |
| ⌘D (or Ctrl+D) | Favorite / unfavorite the highlighted row |

dsh-quick-model-selector README · Usage：The mouse works too: click a row to select, click the star to favorite, click a group header to fold.

Preferences live in `localStorage` under `dsh-quick-model-selector:prefs:v1`, shared across sessions; upgrading from the old package name `dsh-model-palette` migrates the old key automatically, keeping favorites and folded state.

dsh-quick-model-selector README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-quick-model-selector
```

Only its own registration is removed — sessions, model config and preferences stay, and the built-in model picker returns after a restart.

dsh-quick-model-selector README · Development：After editing `src/`, run `npm run build` then `npm test`; `node scripts/preview.mjs <dir>` renders the real components into static pages for layout work.

dsh-quick-model-selector README · Development：Browser interaction tests use React from the local DSH profile and Playwright. They cover keyboard input, toolbar widths from 320–800px, model-name truncation, changing peer labels, and menu boundaries. Provide Playwright through `NODE_PATH` before running `npm test`; set `QMS_BROWSER_CHANNEL=chrome` to use system Chrome. Missing dependencies explicitly skip browser checks; these checks do not replace verification in DSH. Static previews do not run layout observers; verify responsive behavior in the browser and the real host.
